headline: Exchange Flow Reverses To A 406.6 Million Dollar Inflow From An 84.8 Million Dollar Outflow
narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues reversed to a 406.6 million dollar net inflow, 0.1502 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, from an 84.8 million dollar net outflow at 0.0314 percent. Bitfinex took in 135.0 million dollars, Bitstamp took in 129.0 million dollars, and Bybit took in 77.6 million dollars, while Bitget shed 63.3 million dollars. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, so a positive print means dollars arrived where holders can sell and a negative print means dollars left those venues.
author: jordan
